ai_summary: Ritco Logistics Limited has appointed Mr. Ranu Jain, a Chartered Accountant with 16 years of experience in audit, finance, and taxation, as a Non-Executive Independent Director for a five-year term, subject to shareholder approval. This strategic appointment is expected to materially strengthen the board's financial oversight and corporate governance capabilities. No red flags are apparent, as Mr. Jain's profile aligns well with the needs of an independent director, and he is not debarred by any regulatory authority.
